fields.description: Issue includes political commentary and election-related advocacy focused on Dade County voting on repeal/local option (“vote wet”), with discussion of Miami Beach politics and crime. Also contains local columns and letters to the editor, nightlife and entertainment coverage and advertising, radio program schedules, and notices for sporting events including wrestling in Hialeah and auto races at the Miami Motor Speedway.
